basics.name: Hyeongchan Ham
basics.label: M.S. Researcher, KAIST
basics.summary: Practical safety for learning-enabled robots: semantic safety, safe robot learning, and learning-based control.

courses: Expected graduation: February 2027. Advisor: Prof. Heejin Ahn.

work.name: KAIST Control and Intelligent Systems Lab
highlights: Developed latent-space semantic safety methods combining learned visual world representations with Hamilton–Jacobi reachability (S2-NAMO).
Developed evidential uncertainty-aware distributionally robust MPC for autonomous driving (DRO-EDL-MPC).
Developing safety-aware VLA navigation in an ADD-sponsored project.
Developed PAC-Bayesian active learning with pseudo-labeling, validated on semiconductor process data in a Samsung Electronics-sponsored project.

work.name: Agency for Defense Development — AI Autonomy Center
highlights: Developed real-time small-object detection and tracking for multi-UAV systems; optimized and validated models on onboard edge devices.
Built ROS2-based LiDAR perception and 3D detection for UGVs, with pseudo-labeling and multi-agent auto-labeling.
Integrated autonomy software on a full-scale UGV and conducted off-road field experiments.

work.name: OMNIA — UNIST System Laboratory
highlights: Developed an efficient replay-buffer data-loading system for continual learning experiments.
